song.author: Brooke Fraser
song.title: Desert Song
song.lyrics:
[V1] .Am G F C This is my prayer in the desert . Am G F When all that's within me feels dry .Am G F C This is my prayer in my hunger and need . Am G F My God is the God who provides
[V2] .Am G F C And this is my prayer in the fire . Am G F In weakness or trial or pain .Am G F C There is a faith proved of more worth than gold . Am G F So refine me Lord through the flame
[C1] . C G And I will bring praise, I will bring praise . F C No weapon formed against me shall remain . G/B G Am I will rejoice, I will declare . F G Am God is my victory and He is here
[V3] .Am G F C And this is my prayer in the battle . Am G F When triumph is still on its way .Am G F C I am a conqueror and co-heir with Christ . Am G F So firm on His promise I'll stand
[B1] . C All of my life in every season . Am You are still God . G I have a reason to sing . F C I have a reason to worship
[V4] .Am G F C And this is my prayer in the harvest . Am G F When favour and providence flow .Am G F C I know I'm filled to be emptied again . Am G F The seed I've received I will sow
